headword: {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}

definitions.explanation: A shipping option in which an order placed is delivered to the recipient on the same day it is ordered. Offered by many online retailers and services in Japan.

examples.japanese: {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{午前|ごぜん}{中|ちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}すれば→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧{即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です。
examples.english: If you order in the morning, same-day delivery is possible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いでいる→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Since I was in a hurry, I chose the same-day delivery service.

examples.japanese: {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: Same-day delivery is available only in certain areas.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧ (same day, that very day) + ⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧ (delivery, shipping). A common commercial term in Japan for fast-delivery services offered by online retailers like Amazon, Rakuten, and major department stores.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: same-day delivery available
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: same-day delivery supported
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: same-day delivery service
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: free same-day delivery
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧: same-day delivery deadline (cutoff time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧: next-day delivery — delivery the day after ordering
- ⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧: day-of delivery — essentially synonymous with {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう}
- ⟦{速達|そくたつ}→速達：04393_sokutatsu⟧: express mail — the postal service's fast option

USAGE:
Typically subject to conditions: orders must be placed before a cutoff time (e.g., ⟦{午前|ごぜん}{中|ちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧) and are often available only in certain service areas.
